# Global Examination of Mental State

::: {.lead}
Three free, validated tools for the brief assessment of cognition: in person, by telephone, or self-administered on the web.
Each comes with normative data, cut-offs that account for cognitive reserve, and all materials needed to use it.
:::
:::

::: {.container-lg}

::: {.modules}

::: {.module}
[<i class="bi bi-clipboard2-pulse"></i>]{.module-icon}

[In person · paper and pencil]{.module-mode}

::: {.module-title}
[GEMS](tests/gems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.module-desc}
A paper-and-pencil screening of global cognition with 11 tasks covering orientation, memory, attention, visuo-spatial skills, language and pragmatics. It takes about 10 minutes.
:::

<i class="bi bi-unlock"></i>

### Free and open

Record forms, instructions, scoring sheets and code are released under a Creative Commons licence on OSF.
:::

::: {.strip-item}
<i class="bi bi-people"></i>

### Large normative samples

The norms are based on 600 to 1,300 healthy adults per test, covering the adult lifespan.
:::

::: {.strip-item}
<i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i>

### Cognitive reserve

The cut-offs account for age, sex, education and the Cognitive Reserve Index (CRIq).
:::

::: {.strip-item}
<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i>

### Built for follow-up

Parallel forms A and B and significant-change thresholds support repeated assessments.
:::
:::

:::
